newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenyan coffee market remains strong. [CORRECTED 08:50 GMT 06/11]
newsitem.headline: Kenyan coffee market remains strong. [CORRECTED 08:50 GMT 06/11]

text.p: The Kenyan coffee market remained strong on Tuesday with good prices for all grades at the weekly Kenyan auction, auction officials said.
Grade C averaged $140 per 50 kg bag, unchanged from last week. Grade AB averaged $148.88 (corrects price) from $147, but grade AA rose to an average of $155 from $148.
"Higher prices will continue due to reduced quantities until the main crop starts in January," a trader said
The Coffee Board of Kenya said it sold 21,038 60-kg bags out of the 21,152 bags it had on offer and compared with the 20,289 bags sold last week.
